testPlans.content:
Test Plan Document

Objective:
The objective of this test plan is to ensure that the SSA project, including both the recruiter and customer apps, functions as expected and meets the requirements specified in the project description. 

Scope:
This test plan will cover testing of the following functionalities:
1. User registration and login
2. Job application process
3. Chat functionality between users and recruiters
4. Posting jobs by recruiters
5. Notification system for job updates
6. Following recruiters

Approach:
The testing will be conducted using a combination of manual and automated testing techniques. Test cases will be designed to validate each functionality and its interactions with other components of the system. 

Entry Criteria:
- The development of the project is complete
- All functionalities are implemented as per the design requirements
- Test environment is set up and ready for testing

Exit Criteria:
- All critical bugs are fixed and verified
- Test cases have been executed with a high pass rate
- The project is ready for deployment to production

Risks:
- Integration issues between recruiter and customer apps
- Unforeseen technical challenges during testing
- Inadequate test coverage leading to missed defects

Timeline:
Testing will commence on [start date] and is expected to be completed by [end date]. The timeline may be adjusted based on the complexity of issues encountered during testing.

This test plan document is subject to review and may be updated as needed throughout the testing process.

Test Plan Document 

Objective: 
The objective of this test plan is to ensure the quality and functionality of the AmozIT project and to validate that all the features, services, and applications work as intended.

Scope:
The scope of this test plan includes testing the customer app, service provider app, company admin panel, and super admin panel. The testing will cover functionality, user experience, performance, security, and scalability.

Approach:
The testing approach will include manual testing for the customer and service provider apps, as well as automated testing for the company admin panel and super admin panel. Test cases will be written and executed to verify the expected behavior of the system.

Entry Criteria:
- All software components are installed and configured properly
- Test environment is set up and ready for testing
- Test data is available for executing test cases

Exit Criteria:
- All identified defects are resolved and retested
- Test coverage is achieved for all functional and non-functional requirements
- Test reports are generated and reviewed

Risks:
- Lack of test environment stability
- Inadequate test data for comprehensive testing
- Delays in development impacting the testing schedule

Timeline:
The test plan will be executed over a period of 2 weeks, starting on [start date] and ending on [end date].

This document outlines the test plan for the AmozIT project and will serve as a guideline for the testing team to ensure the success of the project.

testCases.title: Submit job application successfully as a customer
testCases.preconditions: Customer is logged into the system
steps: Fill out all required fields in the job application form
Click on the submit button
testCases.expectedResult: Job application is successfully submitted and stored in the system

testCases.title: View submitted job application as a customer
testCases.preconditions: Customer is logged into the system and has submitted a job application
steps: Navigate to the job applications section
Find and click on the submitted job application
testCases.expectedResult: Customer is able to view the details of their submitted job application

testCases.title: Recruiter views job application
testCases.preconditions: Recruiter is logged into the system and has job applications to review
steps: Navigate to the job applications section
Find and click on a job application to review
testCases.expectedResult: Recruiter is able to view the details of the job application and make a decision

testCases.title: Recruiter responds to job application
testCases.preconditions: Recruiter is logged into the system and viewing a job application
steps: Review the job application details
Select a response option (e.g. accept, reject, schedule interview)
Add any relevant feedback or comments
Click on the submit button
testCases.expectedResult: Recruiter's response is recorded and the applicant is notified accordingly

testCases.title: Verify service provider can log in to the app
steps: 1. Open the app
2. Enter valid credentials and tap on the login button
testCases.expectedResult: Service provider is successfully logged in to the app
testCases.scenarioTitle: Test user experience for service provider app

testCases.title: Verify service provider can view their assigned tasks
testCases.preconditions: Service provider is logged in to the app
steps: 1. Navigate to the dashboard section
2. View the list of assigned tasks
testCases.expectedResult: Service provider can see a clear list of their assigned tasks
testCases.scenarioTitle: Test user experience for service provider app

testCases.title: Verify service provider can update task status
testCases.preconditions: Service provider has an assigned task
steps: 1. Open the specific task details page
2. Update the task status
testCases.expectedResult: Task status is successfully updated and reflected in the app
testCases.scenarioTitle: Test user experience for service provider app

testCases.title: Verify service provider can easily navigate to different app sections
testCases.preconditions: Service provider is logged in to the app
steps: 1. Explore the menu options for different sections
2. Navigate to different sections like tasks, profile, settings, etc.
testCases.expectedResult: Service provider can easily switch between app sections without any confusion
testCases.scenarioTitle: Test user experience for service provider app

testCases.title: Verify service provider can receive notifications for new tasks
testCases.preconditions: Service provider is logged in to the app
steps: 1. Wait for a new task to be assigned
2. Check for notifications or alerts on the app
testCases.expectedResult: Service provider receives timely notifications for new tasks to be completed
testCases.scenarioTitle: Test user experience for service provider app

testCases.title: Verify that company admin can only enter alphanumeric characters in the company name field
testCases.preconditions: Company admin is logged into the admin panel
steps: Enter special characters in the company name field
Submit the form
testCases.expectedResult: Error message should be displayed indicating invalid characters
testCases.scenarioTitle: Validate data input for company admin panel

testCases.title: Ensure that company admin must enter a valid email address in the email field
testCases.preconditions: Company admin is logged into the admin panel
steps: Enter an invalid email address format
Submit the form
testCases.expectedResult: Error message should be displayed indicating invalid email address
testCases.scenarioTitle: Validate data input for company admin panel

testCases.title: Check that company admin must select a valid country from the dropdown menu
testCases.preconditions: Company admin is logged into the admin panel
steps: Select an invalid country from the dropdown menu
Submit the form
testCases.expectedResult: Error message should be displayed indicating invalid country selection
testCases.scenarioTitle: Validate data input for company admin panel

testCases.title: Verify that company admin must enter a valid phone number in the phone number field
testCases.preconditions: Company admin is logged into the admin panel
steps: Enter an invalid phone number format
Submit the form
testCases.expectedResult: Error message should be displayed indicating invalid phone number
testCases.scenarioTitle: Validate data input for company admin panel

testCases.title: Ensure that company admin cannot submit the form with any empty mandatory fields
testCases.preconditions: Company admin is logged into the admin panel
steps: Leave one or more mandatory fields empty
Try to submit the form
testCases.expectedResult: Error message should be displayed indicating the required field(s)
testCases.scenarioTitle: Validate data input for company admin panel
